def process_pem_cert(self, data, name, idx):
        """
        Processes PEM encoded certificate
        :param data:
        :param name:
        :param idx:
        :return:
        """
        # Get the certificate
        cert = self.get_certificate(data, name, idx)

        # Get the certificate type
        cert_type = self.get_certificate_type(cert)

        # Get the certificate version
        cert_version = self.get_certificate_version(cert)

        # Get the certificate serial number
        cert_serial = self.get_certificate_serial(cert)

        # Get the certificate issuer
        cert_issuer = self.get_certificate_issuer(cert)

        # Get the certificate subject
        cert_subject = self.get_certificate_subject(cert)

        # Get the certificate not before
        cert_not_before = self.get_certificate_not_before(cert)

        # Get the certificate not after
        cert_not_after = self.get_certificate_not_after(cert)

        # Get the certificate signature algorithm
        cert_signature_algorithm = self.get_certificate_signature_algorithm(cert)

        # Get the certificate signature
        cert_signature = self.get_certificate_signature(cert)

        # Get the certificate extensions
        cert_extensions = self.get_certificate_extensions(cert)

        # Get the certificate public key
        cert_public_key = self.get_certificate_public_key(cert)

        # Get the certificate public key algorithm
        cert_public_key_algorithm = self.get_certificate_public_key_algorithm(cert)

        # Get the certificate public key size

        # Get the certificate public key curve
